anatomical_temporal_projection.diagnosis: PATO/UBERON temporal assertions involve anatomical/cell classes; the local normalized predicates constrain both ends to occurrents. Native relations include existence-starts/ends-during and developmental ordering.
anatomical_temporal_projection.remaining_action: Use native RO/BFO relation definitions and exact class axioms to choose a faithful projection or explicit project convention. Preserve source relation; do not infer events or widen every temporal edge.

bacdive_recipe_projection_conflict.diagnosis: BacDive emits named recipe class assertions with rdf:type and incorrectly attributes their assertions to METPO; the GrowthMedium-only category cohort exposes 16 rows.
bacdive_recipe_projection_conflict.remaining_action: Use recipe-class subclass_of/rdfs:subClassOf with BacDive assertion provenance. Preserve the native METPO parent declaration and growth observations. Rebuild and rerun diagnostics; existing candidate remains unchanged.

chemical_class_specific_exceptions.diagnosis: Most rows satisfy the precise ontology/recipe rule. SE1 Soil Extract 1 (solution:6257) lacks the recipe ChemicalMixture category; the subject cohort also contains the separately reviewed native NCIT Mucin-to-Glycoprotein assertion.
chemical_class_specific_exceptions.remaining_action: Trace the solution declaration and shared material-typing policy upstream; retain independently reviewed native NCIT evidence without admitting arbitrary NCIT subclasses. Do not waive the whole ChemicalEntity signature.

documented_row_convention_supported.diagnosis: Existing exact class/phenotype/role rule holds for every joined endpoint side in this reference cohort.
documented_row_convention_supported.remaining_action: Retain the external diagnostic and original model/graph pins. New graph epochs require a fresh full-row join; this is not a strict or universal scientific pass.

foodon_organism_taxon_relation.diagnosis: All 1,679 rows are FOODON organism-class in_taxon/RO:0002162 assertions to NCBITaxon, not the already supported food-material convention.
foodon_organism_taxon_relation.remaining_action: Review the exact organism-class restriction/mapping meaning against native axioms. Retain original RO semantics; do not assert equality, change to instance membership, or apply the food-material waiver.

foodon_quality_or_process_category.diagnosis: FOODON provider rows include Food-typed quality/process endpoints, e.g. shape/heat-treatment attributes and food fermentation/pickling process classes.
foodon_quality_or_process_category.remaining_action: Derive exact process/quality branch membership from pinned native FOODON axioms and correct authoritative categorization across imports; do not type from labels or change the pinned Biolink schema.

generic_ontology_endpoint_typing.diagnosis: The joined exact cohort contains OntologyClass alone or in a union where the normalized predicate needs a substantive entity/process/quality type. Original suppliers, relations and bounded full-row witnesses are retained.
generic_ontology_endpoint_typing.remaining_action: For every listed supplier/relation cohort, derive missing semantic categories from pinned authoritative ancestry/declarations and test exact relation domain/range. Keep supported imports; do not delete arbitrary ontology classes or grant a generic OntologyClass allowance.

gtdb_endpoint_declaration_gap.diagnosis: 25 phenotype assertions use blank NamedThing GTDB subjects rather than declared taxon nodes; the same rows also prevent complete object-side acceptance.
gtdb_endpoint_declaration_gap.remaining_action: Repair/verify MetaTraits-GTDB endpoint declaration emission using the actual named source species, without inventing an NCBI identity; rebuild and rejoin both diagnostic sides.

imported_gene_category_gap.diagnosis: Two UBERON-imported NCBIGene endpoints (26468,55553) are blank-label OntologyClass nodes under expresses/RO:0002292.
imported_gene_category_gap.remaining_action: Bind gene authority records/identifiers before changing category or label in ontology-stub/source finalization. No blanket namespace-only semantic acceptance.

participant_model_range_conflict.diagnosis: The local Biolink 4.4.2 has_participant range and participates_in domain are occurrent, although their descriptions say continuant. The selected imported rows target/bear substantive continuant categories.
participant_model_range_conflict.remaining_action: Retain original RO/OBI relations and report the pinned-model mismatch separately. Review any narrow projection for each native relation and endpoint pair; do not relabel continuants as processes to make validation pass.

pato_towards_projection.diagnosis: All six PATO quality-to-quality rows preserve RO:0002503 (towards), which the local model narrowly maps to actively_involved_in with a process range.
pato_towards_projection.remaining_action: Correct or explicitly disposition this exact native relational-quality projection using pinned RO/PATO evidence; preserve the qualities and native relation, not a fabricated process interpretation.

taxonomy_hierarchy_representation.diagnosis: These exact category cohorts mix taxonomy/strain hierarchies, inferred parents, imported organism classes and genome-to-taxon rows; a single OrganismTaxon category does not establish the pair.
taxonomy_hierarchy_representation.remaining_action: Bind the existing #834 convention to complete endpoint pairs, raw relation and actual supplier. Separately review assembly-to-taxon versus taxon-to-taxon projection and inferred ancestry; do not turn the category alone into a waiver.

limitations: The CSV loses the opposite endpoint category, so joined counts are endpoint-side occurrences, not original CSV record multiplicities.
Matching a documented precise row-rule is project-profile evidence only, not strict external-model or biological acceptance.
Original witness rows are bounded at three per precise-rule/unmatched bucket; counters cover the complete selected stream.
No authority queries or graph modifications were performed.
No arbitrary future report inherits reference-epoch row-rule coverage. All input CSV records remain unchanged.
Generic ontology cohorts have exact source/relation ownership and witnesses, but lack complete authoritative semantic ancestry; this remaining work is not marked accepted.

reference.evidence_scope: Complete original six-cell CSV diagnostics, not reconstructed endpoint-level graph signatures.
